items.definition:
extremely large; relating to astronomy
The cost of the project was astronomical.

happening at the same time
The two events were concurrent.

doubtful
He made a dubious claim.

relating to a galaxy
We observed a distant galactic cluster.

passed down genetically
The disease is hereditary.

practical and realistic
His pragmatic approach helped solve the problem quickly.

additional; extra
The student received supplemental instruction in math.

relating to projectiles or their flight
The military tested a new ballistic missile.

inborn; natural
She has an innate ability to understand complex problems.

looking back on or dealing with past events or situations
The artist held a retrospective exhibition of her work.

of such excellence, grandeur, or beauty as to inspire great admiration or awe
The view from the mountain top was truly sublime.

relating to the Earth or land
Terrestrial animals live on land, not in water.

relating to both biology and medicine
She works in biomedical research.

difficult to find, catch, or achieve
The truth remained elusive despite their best efforts.

relating to existence
He was grappling with an existential crisis about the meaning of life.

belonging naturally; essential
The intrinsic value of the artwork was immense.

characterized by conflict or disorder
The flight experienced some turbulent weather.

causing shock or dismay
The living conditions were absolutely appalling.

deserving hatred and contempt
His actions were truly despicable.

making or showing an unfair or prejudicial distinction
The company was accused of discriminatory practices.

innovative; pioneering
Her research was truly groundbreaking.

offensive or disgusting by accepted standards of morality and decency
The movie was criticized for its obscene language.

relating to or affecting an ovary or ovaries
She underwent surgery for an ovarian cyst.

relating to, or prescribing punishment, as for crimes or offenses
The country has very strict penal laws against drug trafficking.

sharing in the knowledge of (something secret or private)
Only a few people were privy to the secret information.

relating to or resembling a ghost; of or relating to a spectrum
They saw a spectral figure in the old house.

obvious and unashamed
It was a blatant lie, and everyone knew it.

relating to the neck or cervix
She had a cervical injury from the car accident.

implied though not directly expressed; unquestioning
There was an implicit understanding between them.

relating to or measuring the quality of something rather than its quantity
The study focused on qualitative data, such as interviews and observations.

Lower in rank or position
He holds a subordinate position in the company.

Not certain or fixed
We made a tentative plan for the weekend.

Relating to current events or a specific subject
The discussion focused on topical issues.

of or relating to a bishop or bishops
The church follows an episcopal form of governance.

too powerful to be defeated or overcome
The team seemed invincible after winning so many games.

relating to or resulting from motion
The sculpture was designed to create kinetic energy.

Causing annoyance, anger, or another strong reaction, especially deliberately
His provocative comments sparked a heated debate.

Relating to the kidneys
The patient was diagnosed with chronic renal failure.

relating to the vagina
The doctor discussed vaginal health with the patient.

beaten or shaped by hammering; caused or brought about
The gate was made of beautiful wrought iron.

describing or prophesying the complete destruction of the world
The movie depicted an apocalyptic future.

at or near the center; focused on
The new policy is customer-centric, focusing on user needs.

mild or merciful
The judge was clement in his sentencing.

not authorized by law or rules; born of parents not married to each other
The government declared the election results illegitimate.

forbidden by law, rules, or custom
They were caught engaging in illicit trade.

further back in position; of or nearer the rear or hind end
The posterior part of the brain controls vision.

relating to or suffering from a psychosis
The character displayed psychotic tendencies.

strict, precise, and exacting
The company has stringent quality control standards.

entirely lacking or free from
The desert landscape was devoid of any vegetation.

sumptuously rich, elaborate, or luxurious; very generous
They threw a lavish party with hundreds of guests and expensive decorations.

present, appearing, or found everywhere
Mobile phones are now ubiquitous.

thinking about or planning the future with imagination or wisdom
Steve Jobs was a visionary leader in the tech industry.

of or relating to a college or its students
He enjoyed the collegiate atmosphere of the university.

without considering; regardless of
The rules apply to everyone, irrespective of their position.

relating to the place or time of one's birth
Her natal country was Brazil.

having a firm basis in reality and therefore important, meaningful, or considerable
We need to have a substantive discussion about the budget.

forming or belonging to a base or foundation; fundamental
The basal metabolic rate indicates the energy needed for basic bodily functions.

of or characteristic of the middle class, typically with reference to its perceived materialistic values or conventional attitudes
He criticized the bourgeois values of his parents.

relating to an entrepreneur or entrepreneurship
She has a strong entrepreneurial spirit and is always starting new projects.

relating to a fetus
The doctor monitored the fetal heartbeat during the pregnancy.

relating to meaning in language or logic
The discussion focused on the semantic differences between the two words.

Pointless; useless.
It was futile to try and stop him; he had already made up his mind.

Relating to ice or extremely slow.
The project moved at a glacial pace.

Relating to more than one branch of knowledge.
The research project was highly interdisciplinary, combining biology and engineering.
